concerns.text: Tasks mandate Kaggle GPU inference (`device="cuda"`, `load_in_4bit`, ≤16 GB VRAM, ≤9 h kernel) while constitution Principle VII and spec FR-007/SC-003 require CPU-only inference within the 6 h / 7 GB GitHub Actions budget, reproducible on a fresh Actions runner (Principle I). This is an unflagged three-way contradiction — the tasks document silently replaces the spec's compute constraint rather than amending it.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Compute note & 'Scale deviation' vs spec.md:FR-003, FR-022
concerns.text: FR-003 requires all 27 Table-2 models; FR-022 pre-registers the fallback as 'top-15 models or 10-frame sampling'. Tasks reduce the ensemble to 5 models — beyond even the pre-registered fallback — with no spec amendment authorizing the narrowing. The honest-deviation note does not preserve the constraint.

SC-010 requires demonstrating ≥ 80 % power for d ≈ 0.5 at the final sample size. T009 only computes 'the detectable effect size at that scale' for the reduced design with no verification step or failure condition for the ≥ 80 % criterion — the acceptance criterion is silently dropped.
FR-021 and plan Phase 7 fix the quantisation-control subset at exactly 5 models; T010 says only 'a representative subset of models', leaving the count unspecified relative to both spec and plan.

T001 references `specs/001-llmxive-followup-extending-perception-o/contracts/...` (missing hyphen) while all other references use `001-llmxive-follow-up-...`; the inconsistent path will break schema validation.

concerns.location: tasks.md:artifact paths vs data-model.md:Data Flow Diagram
concerns.text: The data model mandates derived artifacts under `data/derived/`; every task writes to `data/results/` (raw to `data/raw/`). The documented data flow and the task layout disagree — align one or the other.

SC-004 requires ≥ 95 % of outputs to cite an injected context phrase, which is unsatisfiable by definition in baseline and noise conditions; T012 reports 'SC-001–SC-012 status' without noting or conditionally scoping SC-004, so the criterion cannot be honestly verified as written.
